rules: All setup writes must go through live workflow actions only.
Do not use Path 5 or mcp__n8n__patch_workflow_nodes.

cases.title: happy supersede writes replacement embedding
steps: store seed memory via store_memory using step_id namespace E1-seed
supersede that seed via supersede_memory using step_id namespace E1-supersede and distinctive replacement content
verify replacement row active and has supersedes_memory_id backlink to old row according to existing schema contract
verify replacement row embedding IS NOT NULL and dimension=1536

cases.title: idempotent replay does not duplicate replacement row
steps: replay the exact E1 supersede request with same step_id/idempotency key
verify replacement row count remains 1 for that idempotency key
verify old row remains superseded once

cases.title: semantic retrieval sees replacement row
steps: run search_memory with axis-aligned query matching E1 replacement content
verify replacement row appears in semantic result set
prefer top-1 when distinctive; if rank inversion occurs, classify only if row participates and query is short/rare-token

cases.title: invalid target regression
steps: attempt supersede against missing or non-active target using namespace E4-invalid
verify existing error code/shape is preserved

cases.title: store lane regression smoke
steps: run a normal store_memory call after patch using namespace E5-store
verify F6A store lane still writes embedding vector(1536)

cases.title: recall/promote non-target smoke
steps: run one recall_memory and/or promote_memory smoke that does not depend on the changed supersede lane
